description: The plot illustrates the relationship between initial confidence and three accuracy metrics. The x-axis is labeled “Initial Confidence” and has a linear scale ranging from 0.95 to 0.99, with tick labels at intervals of 0.01. The y-axis is labeled “Accuracy” and has a linear scale ranging from 0.0 to 1.0, with tick labels at intervals of 0.2. A blue line, labeled “Final Acc” with circular markers and error bars, begins at approximately 0.82 at x=0.95 and increases to approximately 0.86 at x=0.99. An orange dashed line, labeled “Δ Acc” with diamond markers and error bars, begins at approximately 0.88 at x=0.95 and decreases to approximately 0.83 at x=0.99. A green dashed line, labeled “Initial Acc” with square markers and error bars, begins at approximately 0.03 at x=0.95 and increases to approximately 0.08 at x=0.99.
